text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: AI systems can learn from old data that contains unfair judgments, leading to decisions that discriminate against certain groups. To ensure fairness, developers must carefully check their algorithms and use diverse datasets. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often collects and analyzes huge amounts of personal information, sometimes without clear consent. Transparency matters too—people need to understand how AI makes decisions, especially in areas like hiring or healthcare. Responsible AI development means putting ethics first, not just profits. This requires clear rules, open communication, and constant monitoring to build systems that truly benefit everyone. Ultimately, we must guide technology with human values, not just technical speed.
